title: Safeguarding the Future in the AI Era: Q&A with Sella Nevo
summary_en: Sella Nevo focuses on developing policies to promote the safe and effective use of AI and biotechnology. His mandate at RAND: to help ensure the most pivotal technologies of our time benefit humanity rather than endanger it.
title_cn: Safeguarding the Future in the AI Era: Q&A with Sella Nevo

title: Sustaining Agile Operations: Volume 2, Energy and Water Technology Survey
summary_en: This report analyzes emerging energy and water technologies that could improve operational agility in contested environments. It evaluates advances in portable power, storage, and purification to enhance sustainability and reduce logistics risk.
title_cn: Sustaining Agile Operations: Volume 2, Energy and Water Technology Survey
